title: Measure how a mailbox update wakes an idle session
why: The mailbox is read only at turn start, so an idle session never sees a new message unless something wakes it.
note: Owner ask, 09:33 CST Nov 10 (relayed by the session-messaging topic session, 09:35 CST): "can't we figure out a system to trigger a wake with an update in the mailbox though?" Three routes, none measured: (a) doorbell: mail send also sends a short send_message "check your mail" (works cloud to cloud; cloud to Mac was refused, elevated_session_untrusted_device); (b) each session has a long-lived PR in shivinate7/session-mailbox, each message is also a comment, and the receiver subscribes with subscribe_pr_activity; (c) a GitHub webhook to a session's watch_url (likely blocked: the signing secret is sealed to the artifact service). No wake route is known for the owner's local computer. Done check: one measured wake per route, or "unmeasured" with the reason. A measurement, not a build, so the freeze does not hold it; it needs a second session to comment, so ask the owner before starting one.
